newsitem.title: UK: Ethical says new HRT patch launched in UK.
newsitem.headline: Ethical says new HRT patch launched in UK.

text.p: Ethical Holdings Plc said on Monday that a new type of combination skin patch for use in Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT) had been launched in Britain.

Ethical said in a statement that the patch, which carries the trade name Nuvelle, was able to deliver both oestrogen and progestogen on a controlled basis. It said the combination is intended to relieve the problem of hot flushes experienced by women during and after the menopause.

The patch is being marketed by Schering Health Care Ltd, the British subsidiary of Germany's Schering AG. Ethical said it intended to submit a pan-European application for the patch "in the near future."

Ethical, which is listed on the U.S. Nasdaq market, said Nuvelle is much less bulky than existing combination patches, causes little skin irritation and delivers the active ingredients more steadily, which may reduce unwanted side effects.

The British-based company signed an agreement with G.D. Searle & Co, part of Monsanto Co, in December granting Searle development and marketing rights to Ethical's range of HRT skin patches in the U.S. and other selected markets.
